analyst_view.overall: Early view: Basaksehir (8th) are in form under Nuri Sahin, and Fenerbahce (6th) look a different side under new coach Emre Belozoglu, who won 5-0 at Corum in his first game. Fenerbahce are also in the Champions League and come here after a trip to Kocaelispor and a home game with Erzurumspor, so fatigue and rotation are worth watching.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals. Both sides' games have averaged well over three goals (Fenerbahce 39 in eleven, Basaksehir 36), and Basaksehir scored seven in their last two, so the number looks about right.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.1 corners, split evenly. Two attacking sides make that plausible, and I have nothing specific that changes it.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards. An Istanbul game between a big club and an ambitious home side usually has some edge, but no recent trouble between them is reported, so I stay with the number until the referee is known.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.3 shots. With both teams scoring freely and Fenerbahce's Greenwood and Irfan Can in form, that seems right.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.1 shots on target, which fits two of the league's better attacks; I would only move it once lineups and any Champions League rotation are clear.
